name: Cursor CLI
description: Use the local `cursor-agent` binary (Cursor subscription) as an OpenClaw model backend.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Reuse a local `cursor-agent login` on this host (Cursor subscription).

command.description: Path or name of the cursor-agent binary. Must be an absolute path or a simple binary name (default: cursor-agent). Shell metachars are rejected.

mode.description: Execution mode for cursor-agent. Pick the lowest privilege you need. 'plan' = read-only/planning (recommended when you only want a model provider, no file edits). 'ask' = pure Q&A, no tool use. 'agent' = full coding agent capable of writes/shell. Omit to inherit the legacy headless behavior.

allowTools.description: Controls whether cursor-agent may run its write/shell tools non-interactively. Set false (recommended for untrusted workspaces, and the right choice when using this plugin purely as a text-model provider) to make every tool action require explicit approval. Pairs naturally with mode:"plan" or mode:"ask".

sandbox.description: Forwarded to cursor-agent's --sandbox flag. 'enabled' confines tool actions to a sandbox (recommended for untrusted workspaces). 'disabled' opts out. Omit to inherit cursor-agent's own config.

extraArgs.description: Extra args appended to every cursor-agent invocation (advanced — most users do not need this).
